definitions.explanation: The people who belong to a particular nation.
The general population of a country.

examples.japanese: {国民|こくみん}の{声|こえ}を{聞|き}くべきだ。
examples.english: We should listen to the voice of the people.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{国民|こくみん}として{誇|ほこ}りを{持|も}つ。
examples.english: To be proud as a Japanese citizen.

examples.japanese: {国民|こくみん}{投票|とうひょう}が{行|おこな}われた。
{政府|せいふ}は{国民|こくみん}の{生活|せいかつ}を{守|まも}る{責任|せきにん}がある。{特|とく}に{緊急|きんきゅう}{時|じ}には、{迅速|じんそく}な{対応|たいおう}が{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: The government has a responsibility to protect the lives of its citizens. Especially in emergencies, a swift response is required.

notes:
{国民|こくみん} refers to the citizens or people of a nation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {国民|こくみん}の{権利|けんり} (citizens' rights)
- {国民|こくみん}の{義務|ぎむ} (citizens' duties)
- {全|ぜん}{国民|こくみん} (all citizens)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {国民|こくみん}{投票|とうひょう} (national referendum)
- {国民|こくみん}{年金|ねんきん} (national pension)
- {国民|こくみん}{健康|けんこう}{保険|ほけん} (national health insurance)
- {国民|こくみん}{性|せい} (national character)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国民|こくみん}: citizens (political/legal sense)
- {人民|じんみん}: the people (more political)
- {市民|しみん}: citizens (of a city, or civil rights sense)
- {住民|じゅうみん}: residents
